classification_rule: TRACKS HEALTH when the Spearman interval of the repository estimate against the size-adjusted residual excludes zero. Otherwise CORE-SPECIFIC when Core's interval excludes zero and no seven-year comparison repository has an interval that excludes zero in Core's direction. Otherwise AMBIENT when Core's interval excludes zero, at least half of those repositories share Core's sign, and at least one of those intervals excludes zero. UNDETERMINED in every other case, including a missing estimate. The seven-year minimum is the one already used for the cross-repository table.

what_this_cannot_prove: A correlation between an effect and a size-adjusted residual is not a cause of that residual.
Fewer than 20 repositories make every cross-repository correlation LOW POWER.
A Spearman correlation with fewer than 6 repository estimates is DATA UNAVAILABLE and is not given an interval.
Pull requests GitHub no longer serves are omitted, not scored as having no review.
A list is under-counted only when it still has at least 100 rows and pages_complete is not set.
E3 is not identified outside Core because merged_by was not stored. That absence is not evidence the cascade is Core-specific.
